'''Miep's Bistro''' was a restaurant located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Cineratus]] considered it to have the finest [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and exceptional service.<ref name="Message" />
